issues.title: Loan Simple leads receiving duplicate tasks in post-referral and other workflows
issues.desc: HAs and TCs were receiving duplicate tasks for Loan Simple leads across multiple workflows including post-referral and pre-referral. The issue was caused by a bugged filter related to Loan Simple lead associations in HubSpot. HubSpot support was engaged and the issue was resolved.
issues.workaround: Review affected LS leads from the impact window and manually dismiss or complete duplicate tasks as needed.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow tasks not stopping when deal marked Closed Lost or Transferred
issues.desc: HAs continued receiving post-referral workflow check-in tasks even after deals were marked as Closed Lost or Transferred. The workflow lacked proper exit filters for these deal stages. A tweak to the workflow filters was made to address the issue.
issues.workaround: Manually cancel any outstanding post-referral tasks on deals that were marked Closed Lost or Transferred during the impact window.

issues.title: Automated emails showing previous loan officer after LO change
issues.desc: When a loan officer was changed on a deal, automated emails continued to reference the previous LO rather than the updated one. The fix was handled on the product side. The issue was resolved by Luis.
issues.workaround: Manually resend any automated emails that went out with the incorrect LO information during the impact window.

issues.title: Offer Accepted workflow not re-enrolling deals that previously fell through
issues.desc: The TC Assignment Workflow did not allow re-enrollment, so when a deal originally enrolled and then fell through and went back to Offer Accepted, TC tasks and assignments did not trigger the second time. This affected deals such as Brandee Smith's where the deal stage flipped back and forth. The workflow was updated to allow re-enrollment.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll affected deals into the TC assignment workflow to ensure TC tasks and assignments are created.

issues.title: MRC and other TC Sale Pending and Offer Accepted workflows not enrolling leads
issues.desc: TC workflows for Sale Pending and Offer Accepted stages were not triggering correctly for MRC and other publisher leads between February 26th and April 1st, resulting in TCs not receiving tasks. The root cause was not fully disclosed but HubSpot support was involved in the resolution. The impact window was confirmed as February 26th through April 1st.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll any MRC or publisher leads that moved to Sale Pending or Offer Accepted between February 26th and April 1st into the appropriate TC workflow.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow not triggering for referral accepted on March 18th
issues.desc: A HA reported receiving no tasks after a referral was made and accepted on March 18th. The root cause was an error in how data was pulling, preventing the workflow from filtering correctly. The issue was escalated to the product team for resolution.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll the affected lead into the post-referral workflow and complete any missed tasks from the impact window.

issues.title: Buyer credit SMS sent at Offer Accepted stage without credit amount populated
issues.desc: An SMS notifying buyers of their credit amount was being triggered at the Offer Accepted stage before closing information had been submitted, resulting in a message with no dollar amount. The SMS should only send at the Sale Pending stage once the credit amount is known. The issue was identified as a Dash-triggered communication and escalated to the product team.
issues.workaround: Manually send the buyer credit SMS with the correct amount to any buyers who received the blank credit SMS during the impact window.
